$description: Foundation tokens: breakpoint. Every leaf has value + evidence + measuredFrom. Values come only from the clone source and CLONE_SPEC.md; nothing is invented.
$schemaNote: A leaf is any object with a 'value' key.

ledes-wrap.note: CSR, platform and security ledes go from nowrap to normal wrapping.

platform-stack.note: Platform row becomes a column; padding and type shrink.

phone.note: Hero laptop->phone, use-cases stage->mobile list, integrations 9->5 columns, CSR stage->mobile rows, security 2x2->1 column, closing stage width-driven.

reduced-motion.note: CSS animations off; JS episodes render the final state with no timers (useReducedMotion).

hero-js-match.note: The phone variant is also mounted from JS (usePhone) at the same 720px breakpoint.
